Resurgence California Expands Life-Changing Addiction Treatment in Riverside, Serving Edgemont, March Air Reserve Base, Norco & Rancho Del Sol By: Press Advantage March 19, 2025 at 19:05 PM EDT Jurupa Valley, California - Riverside, CA – Resurgence California continues to set the standard for compassionate and comprehensive treatment, offering a full range of services to help people achieve lasting recovery. Located at 3686 Pacific Ave., in Riverside, CA, Resurgence California is a trusted destination for those seeking sobriety. With a team of dedicated professionals and an evidence-based approach to treatment, the center provides a safe and supportive environment designed to promote healing and transformation.
Every aspect of care at Resurgence California is tailored to meet each patient's unique needs, ensuring they receive the tools and support necessary to reclaim their lives. People searching for an alcohol rehab center in Riverside or a drug rehab in Riverside, California, will find expert guidance, a nurturing atmosphere, and a community of support that fosters lasting change. The facility offers a comprehensive range of services, including alcohol detox, drug detox, inpatient residential treatment, outpatient care, and extended recovery programs. Each program is designed to provide the highest level of care while focusing on long-term sobriety and personal growth.
The impact of Resurgence California’s work is evident in the heartfelt testimonials of those who have received treatment. A recent five-star review from a patient named Thomas R. highlights the profound difference the center has made in his life. “ This place literally saved my life. The staff is on point; they actually care about your well-being. I highly, highly recommend this place. If you have a substance abuse problem, just reach out and take the first step to recovery using Resurgence. I promise they will get you on the right path to sobriety. Shout out to all the staff—you guys are amazing. ” These words capture the genuine care and commitment of the team, reinforcing why Resurgence California remains a top choice for treatment.
Resurgence California is committed to delivering exceptional care through clinical therapy, holistic healing, and personalized treatment plans. The alcohol treatment center provides comprehensive alcoholism treatment programs that focus on both physical and emotional well-being. Patients benefit from medically supervised alcohol detox, ensuring a safe and comfortable transition as they begin their recovery journey. With a focus on evidence-based care, people receive the guidance they need to navigate the challenges of early sobriety while building a strong foundation for the future.
For those in need of drug detox, Resurgence California offers medical oversight and therapeutic support to help patients safely cleanse their bodies while addressing the underlying issues that contribute to substance use. The drug rehab program incorporates structured therapy, counseling, and skill-building techniques designed to empower people in their journey to recovery. Each person receives individualized attention, allowing them to gain the confidence and knowledge needed to sustain long-term success.
Recognizing that each person’s circumstances differ, Resurgence California offers flexible treatment options, including outpatient programs for those who require a structured recovery approach while maintaining their personal and professional responsibilities. Through group and individual therapy, patients develop essential coping strategies and relapse prevention techniques, equipping them with the tools needed to lead fulfilling, sober lives. Focusing on treating the whole person, Resurgence California integrates holistic therapies and lifestyle changes that support long-term recovery.
Resurgence California proudly serves patients across Riverside and surrounding areas, including Edgemont, March Air Force Reserve Base , Norco , and Rancho Del Sol. The center’s reach extends to those seeking an alcohol rehab near me or a reputable treatment center dedicated to excellence. By providing compassionate care and a structured path to sobriety, Resurgence California remains a leader in the field, helping people build healthier, more fulfilling lives.
For those ready to take the first step toward lasting recovery, Resurgence California offers a welcoming and supportive environment where people receive the highest level of care. The facility’s commitment to excellence and its proven track record of success make it the premier choice for alcohol rehab and drug rehab in Riverside, California. By choosing Resurgence California, patients gain access to a team that genuinely cares, a structured treatment plan that works, and a community that will continue to uplift and support them throughout their journey.
